ValidationRule.description: R-VG5: on a saved entry, the status fields change only for a user with Manage Volunteers, also while automation is paused. New entries are not checked, so a paused import may load past hours already Approved.
ValidationRule.errorConditionFormula: AND( NOT(ISNEW()), OR( ISCHANGED(Status__c), ISCHANGED(Approved_By__c), ISCHANGED(Approved_Date__c), ISCHANGED(Rejection_Reason__c) ), NOT($Permission.Manage_Volunteers) )
ValidationRule.errorMessage: Only a volunteer coordinator with the Manage Volunteers permission can approve, reject or reopen volunteer hours.
